items.title: Syntelab Creative 1.2
items.body:
A cleaner window. The logo and the apps are at the top left, Settings at the top right, and What's new, Feedback and Support sit at the bottom of the tools list, which you can now widen by dragging its edge. Search opens a palette that finds apps, tools and commands as you type. When a document hides the start page, the house icon next to the tabs brings it back.

PDF Organizer has a new look and a new rail beside the pages: thumbnails, bookmarks, attached files and signatures, each with a count. At the bottom of the rail you can type a page number, step through pages, rotate the view, choose the page layout and set the zoom with a slider. Every panel beside the pages can be resized by dragging.

Signed PDFs are checked as soon as they open. A line above the pages tells you whether all signatures are valid, and the signature panel is one click away. Certificates you sign with often can be marked as favorites.

Bookmarks are easier to read, and right-click "Combine files" now also takes Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text files.

In Units, the table no longer stops at 20 rows: scroll as far as you like and type anywhere.

Thank you for your feedback. Keep it coming: it decides what comes next.

items.title: Syntelab Creative 1.1
items.body:
Each app now has its own window. PDF Organizer, Scribe, Dev and Units open side by side, each with its own icon on the taskbar, and you switch between them from the logo at the top. A new theme or language shows in every window at once.

PDF pages are much sharper. PDF Organizer now draws them with PDFium, the PDF engine of Google Chrome: text stays crisp at any zoom, and zooming is smooth, without flicker.

Signing many files has its own tab: add the files, choose the certificate and where the signature goes, and check each file in a preview you can zoom. Here and in Batch processing, the columns and the list of files can be resized by dragging.

PDF files in File Explorer now show the PDF Organizer icon.

Thank you for your feedback. Keep it coming: it decides what comes next.

items.title: Syntelab Creative 1.0
items.body:
The first public version: four apps in one window, free and open source.

PDF Organizer views, organizes, combines, edits and signs PDFs. Scribe is a text editor with tools to clean, sort, compare and transform text. Dev brings tools for developers. Units is the most powerful and intuitive unit converter: length, temperature, currency and many more.

No telemetry: nothing leaves your computer unless you ask for it. The program is not limited in any way; each app can do as much as your computer can handle.

Your feedback is essential. It helps us fix bugs, improve what is there and decide on new features and apps. Syntelab Creative will grow with what you tell us.
